title: Altermagnetic memcapacitors
summary: We propose a spintronic memcapacitance effect based upon altermagnetic multiferroic materials. We identify the rare-earth vanadates RVO$_3$ as a concrete platform, with all key parameters tied to measured properties. Under an oscillating electric field, the resulting charge and spin currents trace pinched hysteresis loops that close tangentially at zero field -- the hallmark of memcapacitive, type-2 memdevice behavior -- with charge current densities exceeding, by a factor of about 3.6, the lowest deterministic switching current density reported for optimized spin-transfer-torque magnetic tunnel junctions. We model the system theoretically as a dimerized two-orbital $d$-wave altermagnetic lattice via a Su--Schrieffer--Heeger-type bond modulation, in the spirit of the spin-dependent Rice--Mele model, thereby coupling the altermagnetic order to field-switchable charge and spin polarizations. The associated polarization loops close tangentially at zero field and yield a sign-changing, history-dependent ``butterfly'' differential capacitance, identifying the device as a genuine memcapacitor. Both responses are protected by the same inversion symmetry, so charge and spin channels switch simultaneously with no separate control needed. These results establish altermagnetic multiferroics, realized concretely in RVO$_3$, as an efficient, non-volatile platform for combined electric and spintronic memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于交替磁多铁材料的自旋电子忆容效应，以稀土钒酸盐RVO₃为具体平台，在振荡电场下产生具有忆容特征的磁滞回线（电荷和自旋电流在零场切向闭合），电荷电流密度超过优化自旋转移矩磁隧道结最低确定性开关电流密度的3.6倍。
AI.motivation: 传统忆容器/忆阻器件在电荷和自旋通道的协同控制上存在困难，需要分别控制。交替磁多铁材料具有同时耦合电荷、自旋和晶格自由度的潜力，可望实现无需额外控制的电学和自旋电子学联合存储器。
AI.method: 将体系建模为二聚化双轨道d波交替磁晶格，采用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger型键调制，类似自旋依赖的Rice-Mele模型，将交替磁序与场可切换的电荷和自旋极化耦合起来。所有关键参数均与实际测量的RVO₃材料性质绑定。
AI.result: 在振荡电场下，电荷和自旋电流均呈现零场切向闭合的磁滞回线（忆容型type-2忆器件特征），电荷电流密度比优化STT-MTJ的最低确定性切换电流密度高约3.6倍。极化回路的微分电容呈符号变化的"蝴蝶"历史依赖行为，确认为真正忆容器。电荷和自旋通道受同一反演对称性保护，可同时切换。
AI.conclusion: 交替磁多铁材料（具体为RVO₃）可作为高效、非易失性的联合电学和自旋电子学存储平台，实现电荷与自旋通道的同步切换，无需独立控制。

title: Mirror Chern insulators in two-dimensional altermagnetic Tc$_2$Cl$_2$O and Tc$_2$Br$_2$O
summary: The interplay between altermagnetism and crystalline band topology provides an intriguing avenue for realizing unconventional topological phases with distinctive spin-dependent properties. Here, based on first-principles calculations and theoretical analysis, we identify monolayer $\mathrm{Tc}_2X_2\mathrm{O}$ ($X$ = Cl, Br) as a family of two-dimensional altermagnetic mirror Chern insulators. In the absence of spin--orbit coupling (SOC), both monolayers exhibit robust altermagnetism with mirror-spin coupling and host two symmetry-protected Weyl points in each spin channel near the Fermi level. The Weyl points in opposite spin channels carry distinct mirror-symmetry eigenvalues, $m_z=\pm i$. Upon inclusion of SOC, the Weyl points are gapped, and the two mirror sectors acquire opposite Chern numbers, ${\cal {C}}_{+}=1$ and ${\cal {C}}_{-}=-1$, resulting in a nonzero mirror Chern number ${\cal {C}}_m=1$. A low-energy $k\cdot p$ model captures the symmetry protection of the Weyl points and elucidates their SOC-induced mass gaps and topological character. Furthermore, the resulting mirror Chern insulating phases host helical edge states within the bulk band gap and exhibit a quantized spin Hall conductivity. Our work establishes a direct connection between altermagnetism and mirror Chern topology and provides a promising platform for exploring unconventional topological and spin-dependent phenomena in two-dimensional altermagnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和理论分析，识别出单层Tc₂X₂O（X=Cl, Br）作为二维交替磁（altermagnetic）镜面陈数绝缘体家族。无自旋轨道耦合时表现出强交替磁性并携带Weyl点，加入SOC后Weyl点打开能隙，产生非零镜面陈数（C_m=1），并表现出量子化自旋霍尔电导。
AI.motivation: 交替磁性与晶体能带拓扑之间的相互作用为实现具有独特自旋依赖性质的非传统拓扑相提供了有趣途径，但目前两者之间的直接联系尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算结合低能k·p模型分析；首先在无SOC情况下识别交替磁性和Weyl点及其镜面本征值，随后引入SOC研究能隙打开和镜面陈数的产生，并分析边界态和自旋霍尔电导。
AI.result: 单层Tc₂X₂O在无SOC时具有强交替磁性，每个自旋通道含两个对称保护的Weyl点（携带m_z=±i镜面本征值）；引入SOC后Weyl点打开能隙，两个镜面扇区获得相反陈数C₊=1和C₋=-1，产生非零镜面陈数C_m=1；体内带隙中出现螺旋边缘态并表现出量子化自旋霍尔电导。k·p模型成功描述了Weyl点的对称保护及其SOC诱导的质量隙和拓扑特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了交替磁性与镜面陈数拓扑之间的直接联系，为在二维交替磁材料中探索非传统拓扑和自旋依赖现象提供了有前景的平台。

title: Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Subsystem Density Functional Theory
summary: We present a new computational approach based on Nuclear-Electronic Orbital and Subsystem Density Functional Theory. The resulting NEO-sDFT methodology enables quantum chemical calculations of large molecular systems composed of thousands of atoms while also describing selected protons quantum mechanically. A key feature of the associated program implementation is its flexibility in assigning quantum protons to subsystems, allowing different embedding schemes to be employed within a unified framework. The accuracy of NEO-sDFT is assessed by computing water dimer interaction energies, which exhibit errors of only a few meV compared to reference Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Density Functional Theory results. The favorable computational scaling of NEO-sDFT is further showcased through calculations on water clusters of increasing size, with up to 303 protons being treated quantum mechanically. Our results demonstrate that NEO-sDFT is an accurate and efficient approach for incorporating nuclear quantum effects into large-scale simulations, providing a foundation for future applications to proton transfer processes in biochemical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于核电子轨道（NEO）与子系统密度泛函理论（sDFT）相结合的新计算方法（NEO-sDFT），能够对包含数千个原子的大分子体系进行量子化学计算，同时量子力学地描述选定的质子。该方法在程序实现上具有灵活性，可将量子质子灵活分配到不同子系统，支持在统一框架内采用不同的嵌入方案。通过水二聚体相互作用能验证了其精度（误差仅为几meV），并通过不同大小的水团簇计算展示了其良好的计算扩展性（最多可量子处理303个质子）。结果表明NEO-sDFT是将核量子效应纳入大规模模拟的准确且高效的方法，为未来在生化体系中质子转移过程的应用奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 大规模分子体系中核量子效应（如质子转移）对化学过程至关重要，但传统方法难以在保持量子描述精度的同时扩展到包含数千原子的大体系。现有的NEO方法虽然能量子描述质子，但计算代价高，难以应用于大分子系统。
AI.method: 将核电子轨道（NEO）方法与子系统密度泛函理论（sDFT）相结合，构建NEO-sDFT框架。该框架允许将量子质子灵活分配给不同子系统，支持多种嵌入方案，从而在统一框架下兼顾大体系计算效率和局部质子的量子描述。
AI.result: 水二聚体相互作用能误差仅为几meV（与参考NEO-DFT结果相比）；水团簇计算中最多可量子处理303个质子，展示出良好的计算扩展性。
AI.conclusion: NEO-sDFT是一种准确且高效的方法，能将核量子效应纳入大规模模拟，为未来生化体系中质子转移过程的研究提供了坚实基础。

title: Josephson transport in YBa${}_{2}$Cu${}_{3}$O${}_{7}$ weak links created by focused-helium-ion-beam irradiation: Analysis based on diffusive-SNS-junction model
summary: Fabrication of YBCO weak links by focused helium ion beam irradiation is a promising approach for realizing high-temperature superconducting Josephson junction devices. Although empirical dose-characteristic relationships have been established, the underlying transport mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we perform a detailed investigation of the transport properties of YBCO weak links fabricated using a helium ion microscope (HIM) and provide a unified phenomenological description of the observed behavior based on the theory of SNS junctions with a diffusive metallic interlayer. We demonstrate that the temperature dependence of the critical current $I_{\mathrm{c}}$ and the $I_{\mathrm{c}}R_{\mathrm{n}}$ product are well described by diffusive SNS junction models over a wide temperature range. Analyses show that the observed dose dependences of $I_{\mathrm{c}}$ and $I_{\mathrm{c}}R_{\mathrm{n}}$ cannot be explained solely by variations in the effective Thouless energy $E_{\mathrm{T}}$. The discrepancy suggests reduced interface transparency and a reduction in the density of states, leading to a decrease in the effective number of conducting channels contributing to transport. This interpretation is also consistent with the observed exponential increase in $R_{\mathrm{n}}$ with irradiation dose. These results provide a diffusion-based framework for understanding Josephson transport and guiding junction design in helium-ion-irradiated YBCO weak links.

AI.tldr: 本文通过氦离子显微镜（HIM）辐照制备YBCO弱连接，并基于扩散型SNS结理论对其输运特性进行统一的现象学描述。研究发现温度依赖的临界电流和IcRn乘积符合扩散SNS结模型，但剂量依赖性无法仅用Thouless能量变化解释，还需考虑界面透射率降低和态密度减小导致的有效导电通道数减少。
AI.motivation: 氦离子束辐照制备YBCO弱连接是构建高温超导约瑟夫森结器件的可行途径，但尽管已建立了经验性的剂量-特性关系，其潜在的输运机制仍不清晰，亟需深入理解。
AI.method: 利用氦离子显微镜制备YBCO弱连接，系统测量其输运性质，并基于具有扩散金属中间层的SNS结理论进行统一的现象学描述分析。通过比较临界电流Ic和IcRn乘积的温度依赖性和剂量依赖性，评估有效Thouless能量、界面透射率和态密度等参数的变化。
AI.result: 临界电流的温度依赖性和IcRn乘积在宽温度范围内均可由扩散SNS结模型很好地描述。剂量依赖性分析表明，仅靠有效Thouless能量的变化不足以解释实验结果，还需考虑界面透射率降低和态密度减少，导致有效导电通道数下降。这一解释与观测到的Rn随辐照剂量指数增加的规律一致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为氦离子辐照YBCO弱连接中的约瑟夫森输运提供了基于扩散的框架理解，可用于指导此类约瑟夫森结器件的设计。

title: Resonant state expansion for acoustic resonators. Part II. Scattering problem
summary: We develop a resonant-state expansion formulation for acoustic scattering by individual resonators. The scattered pressure and particle-velocity fields are expanded over the resonant states of the system, with excitation amplitudes determined by overlap integrals between the incident field and the resonant states over the resonator volume. Using the acoustic energy flux, we derive expressions for the extinction, scattering, and absorption cross-sections and show that the extinction spectrum can be resolved into contributions from individual resonant states. The formulation is first validated for a homogeneous two-dimensional cylinder, where it reproduces the analytical Mie-theory solution. We then consider a sectorally perturbed cylinder with coupled azimuthal modes and demonstrate agreement with finite-element simulations. Finally, we combine the eigenvalue and scattering formulations for a material-programmed hard-wall annular metaatom and reproduce its scattering spectra and near fields. The developed framework provides a physically transparent modal approach to acoustic scattering by open resonators with reduced symmetry and spatially structured material parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于声学散射问题的谐振态展开（RSE）公式，将散射压力和粒子速度场展开为系统的谐振态，通过入射场与谐振态在谐振器体积内的重叠积分确定激发振幅。该公式能够将消光谱分解为单个谐振态的贡献，并在均质圆柱、扇区扰动圆柱和材料编程的硬壁环形元原子三种场景中得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 为具有降低对称性和空间结构化材料参数的开放谐振器提供一种物理上透明、模态化的声学散射分析框架，弥补传统方法在处理这类复杂谐振器时的不足。
AI.method: 基于谐振态展开公式：将散射压力和粒子速度场展开为系统谐振态的叠加；激发振幅由入射场与谐振态在谐振器体积内的重叠积分决定；利用声能量通量推导消光、散射和吸收截面的表达式；将消光谱分解为单个谐振态的贡献。
AI.result: 均质二维圆柱中复现了解析Mie理论解；扇区扰动圆柱（具有耦合方位角模式）与有限元模拟结果一致；材料编程的硬壁环形元原子成功复现了散射谱和近场。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为具有降低对称性和空间结构化材料参数的开谐振器提供了一种物理上清晰的模态化声学散射分析方法，具有良好的有效性和通用性。

title: Statistical complexity from fluctuations in the information content
summary: We argue that the variance of the information content ($C$), an information-theoretic quantity, can be naturally interpreted as a measure of statistical complexity. We show that $C$ satisfies widely accepted criteria for statistical complexity measures: it vanishes for both ordered and equiprobable states, while attaining maxima in intermediate regimes, typically shifted toward order. This interpretation establishes direct connections with thermodynamics and phase transitions: for systems obeying Boltzmann--Gibbs statistics, $C$ is extensive and directly proportional to energy fluctuations and heat capacity. Moreover, unlike other statistical complexity measures, it attains a maximum at continuous phase transitions, as illustrated for the two-dimensional Ising model. Applications to chaotic maps and fractional Gaussian noise further indicate that $C$ captures nontrivial dynamical structure in different classes of correlated systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将信息含量方差C用作统计复杂度的度量，证明其满足统计复杂度度量公认的标准，并在热力学、相变及多种相关系统中展示了其独特优势。
AI.motivation: 现有统计复杂度度量存在局限，无法同时满足有序和等概率状态均为零、在中间状态达到最大等标准，且缺乏与热力学和相变的直接联系。作者希望提出一种兼具理论严谨性和物理可解释性的复杂度度量。
AI.method: 将信息含量C（信息理论量）的方差定义为统计复杂度度量，并从理论层面验证其满足公认标准（有序与等概率状态为零、中间状态达到极大并偏向有序）。同时对Boltzmann-Gibbs统计系统推导C的广延性及其与能量涨落和热容的直接关系，并通过二维Ising模型、混沌映射和分数高斯噪声进行验证。
AI.result: C满足统计复杂度度量的全部公认准则；在Boltzmann-Gibbs系统中C具有广延性且正比于能量涨落和热容；在连续相变（如二维Ising模型）处C达到极大值，这不同于其他统计复杂度度量；在混沌映射和分数高斯噪声等系统中也能捕捉非平凡动力学结构。
AI.conclusion: 信息含量方差C是一种兼具理论正当性和物理意义的新型统计复杂度度量，其与热力学量（热容、能量涨落）的直接联系及其在连续相变处取极值的特性，使其在复杂系统研究中具有独特价值。

title: Antiferromagnetic order and lattice response in DyCuAs$_2$
summary: We report high-resolution synchrotron X-ray diffraction and X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (XRMS) studies of the low-temperature crystal and magnetic structures of DyCuAs$_2$, a member of the \RE{}CuAs$_2$ family exhibiting a resistivity minimum above the antiferromagnetic transition temperature. Synchrotron diffraction measurements reveal that DyCuAs$_2$ preserves tetragonal symmetry down to low temperature within the experimental resolution, although pronounced anomalies in both lattice parameters $a$ and $c$ are observed near the antiferromagnetic transition temperature, $T_{\mathrm N}\approx7$~K, indicating strong magnetoelastic coupling. XRMS measurements at the Dy $L_3$ edge establish commensurate antiferromagnetic ordering below $T_{\mathrm N}$ with AFM Bragg peaks at \qq{} = (0, 0, 0.5). Representation analysis and calculations of the AFM Bragg peak intensities identify the magnetic structure as the $Γ_{10}$ representation, consisting of in-plane Dy moments stacked along the \cc{} axis in a $++--$ sequence. The magnetic structure is therefore identical to that previously reported for SmCuAs$_2$. Comparison among DyCuAs$_2$, SmCuAs$_2$, and GdCuAs$_2$ suggests that in-plane AFM order and the associated magnetic frustration on the tetragonal lattice are closely connected to the emergence of the resistivity minimum in the \RE{}CuAs$_2$ family. At the same time, the enhanced lattice response and stronger magnetic-field sensitivity observed in DyCuAs$_2$ imply that magnetoelastic and spin-orbit interactions additionally play important roles in determining the robustness of this anomalous transport behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过同步辐射X射线衍射和X射线共振磁散射（XRMS）研究了DyCuAs₂的低温晶体和磁结构。研究发现DyCuAs₂在低温下保持四方对称性，但在反铁磁转变温度T_N≈7 K附近存在显著的晶格参数异常，表明强磁弹耦合。X射线共振磁散射确定了反铁磁有序的传播矢量为q=(0,0,0.5)，磁结构属于Γ₁₀表示，为面内Dy磁矩沿c轴以++--序列堆叠。该磁结构与SmCuAs₂相同。通过对比DyCuAs₂、SmCuAs₂和GdCuAs₂，发现面内反铁磁有序及其在四方晶格上的磁阻挫与电阻率极小值的出现密切相关，同时磁弹和自旋-轨道相互作用对异常输运行为的鲁棒性起重要作用。
AI.motivation: 理解RE CuAs₂家族中电阻率极小值现象与磁结构之间的关系，特别是通过确定DyCuAs₂的低温磁结构来探索面内反铁磁有序、磁阻挫与异常输运行为之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率同步辐射X射线衍射研究低温晶体结构，利用X射线共振磁散射（XRMS）在Dy L₃边测量确定磁结构，并结合表示分析和反铁磁Bragg峰强度计算来鉴定磁结构的对称性表示。
AI.result: DyCuAs₂在低温下保持四方对称性，但在T_N附近存在晶格参数异常（磁弹耦合强）。磁结构确定为Γ₁₀表示，传播矢量q=(0,0,0.5)，Dy面内磁矩沿c轴以++--序列堆叠，与SmCuAs₂相同。对比发现面内反铁磁有序和磁阻挫与电阻率极小值密切相关，而DyCuAs₂中更强的晶格响应和磁场敏感性表明磁弹和自旋-轨道相互作用也影响异常输运行为的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DyCuAs₂的磁结构与SmCuAs₂一致，面内反铁磁有序和磁阻挫是RE CuAs₂家族电阻率极小值出现的关键因素，同时磁弹耦合和自旋-轨道相互作用对异常输运行为的稳定性也发挥重要作用。

title: Electronic and chemical phase identification in photoemission experiments using unsupervised machine learning
summary: Vacuum ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopies are very information-rich experiments, but due to their surface sensitivity, data are often collected on an initially uncharacterized surface. Traditional raster-grid approaches for locating optimal measurement regions can be time-consuming. In this work, we introduce AARDVARK, a generalizable framework for sample exploration that leverages dimensionality reduction and Gaussian process regression to guide initial sample searches in spatially-resolved photoemission experiments. By utilizing UMAP as a target for a Gaussian process, the algorithm efficiently identifies boundaries of spectroscopically distinct regions, dynamically adapting to variations in sample characteristics. The algorithm enables real-time decision making in measurement selection, optimizes data acquisition, and presents a robust framework for future autonomous sample exploration in photoemission experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AARDVARK框架，一种用于空间分辨光电子能谱实验中的通用样本探索方法，利用UMAP降维和高斯过程回归来引导初始样本搜索，动态识别光谱不同区域的边界，实现实时决策和数据采集优化。
AI.motivation: 真空紫外光电子能谱实验信息丰富但对表面非常敏感，数据通常需要在未表征的表面上采集。传统的栅格扫描方法寻找最佳测量区域耗时，需要更高效的采样策略。
AI.method: 提出AARDVARK框架，结合UMAP降维作为高斯过程回归的目标，通过算法迭代引导空间分辨光电子实验中的样本搜索，动态适应样本特征变化，实时决定测量位置。
AI.result: 该算法能有效识别光谱上不同区域的边界，实现实时测量决策，优化数据采集效率，为未来的自主样本探索提供了稳健框架。
AI.conclusion: AARDVARK为光电子能谱实验中的样本探索提供了一种通用的自动化框架，能够显著提高测量效率和智能化水平。

title: Valley- and Spin-Dependent Electronic and Transport Properties of Two-Dimensional Altermagnetic Titanium-Based Chalcogenide Halides
summary: Altermagnets (AMs) combine fully compensated magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting, yet intrinsic altermagnetic materials exhibiting exceptional valley characteristics remain scarce. Here, we identify monolayer titanium-based chalcogenide halides, Ti$_2X_2Y$ ($X$ = F, Cl, Br, I; $Y$ = O, S, Se, Te), as a new family of two-dimensional altermagnetic valley materials. These monolayers exhibit robust $d$-wave altermagnetic order, semiconducting band gaps, and pronounced spin-polarized valley characteristics. We show that uniaxial strain breaks the valley degeneracy, inducing giant valley polarization together with a tunable piezomagnetic response. An in-plane electric field generates noncollinear spin currents, while spin--orbit coupling gives rise to the anomalous Hall effect, valley-selective linear dichroism, and the magneto-optical Kerr effect. These findings establish Ti$_2X_2Y$ monolayers as a versatile platform for exploring spin- and valley-dependent electronic, optical, and transport phenomena in two-dimensional altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，识别出一类新的二维交变磁谷材料——单层钛基硫族卤化物Ti₂X₂Y（X=F, Cl, Br, I; Y=O, S, Se, Te），该材料兼具d波交变磁序、半导体带隙和显著的自旋极化谷特性。研究表明单轴应变可打破谷简并，产生巨大谷极化与可调压磁响应；面内电场可产生非共线自旋流，自旋轨道耦合则引发反常霍尔效应、谷选择性线性二色性和磁光克尔效应。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体（AMs）结合了完全补偿磁化与动量依赖的自旋劈裂，但目前具有优异谷特性的本征交变磁性材料仍然稀少，亟需探索新的材料平台。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算，系统研究Ti₂X₂Y单层的电子结构、磁性质、谷特性及应变和电场调控下的自旋与输运行为。
AI.result: Ti₂X₂Y单层展现出稳健的d波交变磁序、半导体带隙和自旋极化谷特性；单轴应变诱导巨大谷极化和可调压磁响应；面内电场产生非共线自旋流；自旋轨道耦合带来反常霍尔效应、谷选择性线二色性和磁光克尔效应。
AI.conclusion: Ti₂X₂Y单层被确立为研究二维交变磁体中自旋与谷相关电子、光学和输运现象的多功能平台。

title: Resonance Raman spectroscopy from ab initio Hagedorn wavepacket dynamics
summary: We present a practical, ab initio time-dependent method using Hagedorn wavepackets to simulate resonance Raman (RR) spectra of polyatomic molecules. Hagedorn functions---Gaussians multiplied by specific polynomials---are used to represent RR initial and final states because these functions are exact solutions to the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for at-most-quadratic potentials and can be propagated at zero cost beyond that of propagating the guiding Gaussian. Using efficient recursive formulae to compute overlaps between Hagedorn wavepackets, we can evaluate RR excitation profiles for arbitrary spectral signals, such as fundamental, overtone, combination, and hot bands. We then construct the Stokes and anti-Stokes RR spectra from these profiles. We first validate the method in a two-dimensional displaced, distorted, and Duschinsky-rotated harmonic model against numerically exact split-operator calculations. Then, we apply the method to compute RR spectra of anthracene by performing dynamics on a 66-dimensional harmonic potential energy surface constructed from density functional theory calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Hagedorn波包的实用从头算含时方法，用于模拟多原子分子的共振拉曼（RR）光谱。Hagedorn函数是高斯函数与特定多项式的乘积，在至多二次势下是含时薛定谔方程的精确解，因此传播成本接近零。通过高效递归公式计算Hagedorn波包间的重叠积分，可评估任意光谱信号（基频、泛频、组合及热谱带）的RR激发轮廓，并构建斯托克斯和反斯托克斯RR光谱。方法先在二维位移、畸变及Duschinsky旋转谐波模型中与数值精确的劈裂算符方法验证，随后应用于66维蒽分子的谐波势能面上的RR光谱计算。
AI.motivation: 传统共振拉曼光谱模拟方法在处理多原子分子时面临较大计算挑战，需要高效且准确的量子动力学方法来计算RR激发轮廓和光谱，特别是在高维分子体系中。
AI.method: 利用Hagedorn波包（高斯函数乘以特定多项式）表示RR初始态和终态，利用其在至多二次势下可零额外成本传播的特性，结合递归公式高效计算波函数间的重叠积分，从而获得各种跃迁的RR激发轮廓，并构建完整的斯托克斯和反斯托克斯RR光谱。
AI.result: 在二维谐波模型上与数值精确的劈裂算符方法验证了一致性；成功应用于66维蒽分子的RR光谱计算，该势能面由密度泛函理论构建。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是一种实用且高效的计算多原子分子RR光谱的手段，能够处理高维谐波势能面，为从第一性原理出发模拟复杂分子共振拉曼光谱提供了可行的途径。

title: Photogalvanic transport of nonreciprocal Cooper-pair fluctuations
summary: We develop a theory of the nonlinear optical and transport responses of two-dimensional noncentrosymmetric superconductors in the fluctuation regime above the transition temperature, encompassing the photogalvanic effect, second-harmonic generation, and the photovoltaic Hall effect. In the vicinity of the transition these responses are strongly enhanced by preformed Cooper pairs, whose nonreciprocity enters the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau description in two physically distinct ways: through thermodynamic Lifshitz invariants, which encode an asymmetric pair spectrum, and through kinetic Lifshitz invariants, which encode an asymmetric pair relaxation and are locked to the Langevin noise by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. We derive generalized master formulas for the paraconductivity (Aslamazov-Larkin) and the quantum-interference (Maki-Thompson) channels of the nonlinear current, valid at arbitrary drive frequency and to linear order in the nonreciprocal perturbations, and reduce them to closed-form dimensionless functions. Circular polarization discriminates sharply between the mechanisms: for reciprocal momentum-structureless noise the Aslamazov-Larkin channel is polarization insensitive and its circular photogalvanic response vanishes for any pair spectrum, whereas the Maki-Thompson channel and the nonreciprocal noise support helicity-odd rectified currents, including a fluctuation photovoltaic Hall current flowing transverse to the strain axis. Applications to Rashba-type ($C_{3v}$) and Ising-type ($D_{3h}$) superconductors demonstrate how the point-group symmetry dictates the allowed vector structures of the nonlinear currents, and how polarization analysis together with the frequency and dephasing dependences can be used to separate the individual channels experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了二维非中心对称超导体在转变温度以上涨落区间的非线性光学与输运响应理论，涵盖光电流效应、二次谐波产生和光伏霍尔效应。通过时间相关Ginzburg-Landau理论中引入热力学和动力学Lifshitz不变量描述超导配对涨落的非互易性，推导了Aslamazov-Larkin和Maki-Thompson通道的广义非线性电导主公式，并应用于Rashba型和Ising型超导体。
AI.motivation: 理解非中心对称超导体在涨落区间的非线性光学和输运响应，特别是预形成Cooper对如何增强这些响应，以及圆偏振光如何区分不同的物理机制。
AI.method: 基于时间相关Ginzburg-Landau理论，通过热力学Lifshitz不变量（编码非对称配对谱）和动力学Lifshitz不变量（编码非对称配对弛豫，受涨落-耗散定理约束）引入非互易性。推导了非线性电流的Aslamazov-Larkin（超导电导率）和Maki-Thompson（量子干涉）通道的广义主公式，适用于任意驱动频率和非互易微扰的线性阶。
AI.result: 发现Aslamazov-Larkin通道对圆偏振不敏感，其圆光电流响应对任何配对谱均消失；而Maki-Thompson通道和非互易噪声支持螺旋度奇异的整流电流，包括垂直于应变轴的涨落光伏霍尔电流。应用于Rashba型(C3v)和Ising型(D3h)超导体，展示了点群对称性如何决定非线性电流的矢量结构。
AI.conclusion: 圆偏振极化可以清晰地区分两种物理机制，结合偏振分析、频率和退相干依赖可以将各个通道在实验中分离。点群对称性决定了非线性电流的允许矢量结构，为实验设计提供了理论指导。

title: Exact partition function of arithmetic Ising model
summary: We present a compact formula for the exact partition function of the $d$-dimensional arithmetic Ising model (AIM). For a $2\times2$ system, we express it analytically using the $q$-Hurwitz-Lerch zeta function and derive explicit forms for the free energy and entropy. Additionally, we find that the entropy increases at high temperatures, supporting the presence of entropic order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了d维算术Ising模型（AIM）精确配分函数的紧凑公式。对于2×2系统，利用q-Hurwitz-Lerch zeta函数给出解析表达式，并推导出自由能和熵的显式形式。研究发现高温下熵增加，支持了熵序的存在。
AI.motivation: 算术Ising模型是统计力学中的重要模型，但其精确配分函数往往难以解析求解。作者希望找到一种紧凑的解析公式来描述该模型的配分函数，并进一步理解系统在高温下的熵行为及其与熵序现象的联系。
AI.method: 通过数学分析方法，利用q-Hurwitz-Lerch zeta函数将d维算术Ising模型的配分函数表达为紧凑的解析形式；对2×2系统进行具体求解，推导自由能和熵的显式表达式，并分析高温极限下的熵行为。
AI.result: 成功获得配分函数的紧凑解析公式；对2×2系统给出了自由能和熵的显式形式；发现高温下熵增加，这一现象支持熵序的存在。
AI.conclusion: 本文为算术Ising模型提供了精确且紧凑的解析解，并通过熵在高温下的行为证实了熵序的存在，为该模型的进一步理论研究和应用奠定了基础。

title: Universality of long-wavelength behavior of composite-fermion Fermi liquid
summary: A recent article evaluated the long-wavelength behavior of the projected static structure factor of the composite-fermion (CF) liquid within the zeroth-order microscopic theory and found $\bar{S}(\mathbf{q})\sim q^3$, in disagreement with the $\bar{S}(\mathbf{q})\sim q^3\ln q$ behavior predicted by the Chern-Simons field theory for the Coulomb interaction. Here we consider the possibility that the discrepancy arises because the zeroth-order CF Fermi-liquid wave function used in that work does not properly capture the long wavelength behavior. We use CF diagonalization to significantly improve the wave function but do not find any evidence for $\bar{S}(\mathbf{q})\sim q^3 \ln q$ behavior. Additionally, we find that the small-$q$ behavior of $\bar{S}(\mathbf{q})$ is also insensitive to the form of the interaction between electrons, suggesting universality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了复合费米子（CF）液体投影静态结构因子$\bar{S}(q)$的长波行为。先前研究发现零阶微观理论给出$\bar{S}(q)\sim q^3$，与Chern-Simons场论预测的$q^3\ln q$行为不一致。作者通过CF对角化改进波函数，但未发现$q^3\ln q$的证据，且$\bar{S}(q)$的小$q$行为对电子间相互作用形式不敏感，显示出普适性。
AI.motivation: 解决零阶CF微观理论与Chern-Simons场论之间关于投影静态结构因子长波行为（$q^3$ vs $q^3\ln q$）的定量分歧，并探究该分歧是否源于零阶波函数未能正确捕捉长波行为。
AI.method: 使用CF对角化方法显著改进CF费米液体波函数（取代零阶理论中的近似波函数），重新计算投影静态结构因子的长波行为，并测试不同电子间相互作用形式下小$q$行为的敏感性。
AI.result: 即使使用改进后的CF对角化波函数，也未发现$\bar{S}(q)\sim q^3\ln q$行为的证据；同时发现$\bar{S}(q)$的小$q$行为对电子间相互作用形式不敏感，暗示该行为具有普适性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明$\bar{S}(q)\sim q^3\ln q$行为可能并非CF液体的真实物理性质，分歧不源于波函数近似，而$\bar{S}(q)$的小$q$行为表现出的普适性值得进一步从理论上理解。

title: Twisted magnon frequency combs in ferromagnetic nanorings
summary: We report the emergence of twisted magnon frequency combs (tMFCs) and their higher-order modes in ferromagnetic nanorings, arising from strong nonlinear coupling between vortex-core gyration and azimuthal spin-wave modes. The comb lines carry distinct orbital angular momentum with quantum numbers spaced by unity, and their formation obeys selection rules governed by simultaneous conservation of energy and angular momentum. We demonstrate that the hole diameter serves as a powerful tuning parameter: reducing the hole size preserves the conventional tMFC, whereas increasing it introduces an additional magnon mode that dramat?ically densifies the comb via four-wave mixing, boosting the sideband multiplicity by an order of magnitude. Moreover, an external in-plane magnetic field enables continuous, reversible tuning of the comb spacing by dis?placing the vortex core and modifying its confinement potential, with the hole-induced geometric pinning giving rise to asymmetric switching and hysteresis under opposite field polarities. Our results establish the tMFC as a versatile platform for nonlinear magnonics, with potential applications in tunable frequency comb generation and precision metrology.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了铁磁纳米环中由于涡旋核旋进与方位角自旋波模式之间的强非线性耦合而产生的扭曲磁振子频率梳（tMFC）及其高阶模式。梳状谱线携带不同轨道角动量，其形成受能量和角动量守恒选择定则支配。研究发现孔洞直径可作为有效调控参数，而外加面内磁场可实现梳间距的连续可逆调谐，为非线性磁振子学和精密计量提供了多功能平台。
AI.motivation: 探索磁振子频率梳这一非线性磁振子学中的新兴现象，特别关注其在铁磁纳米结构中的产生机制与调控手段，以拓展频率梳技术的应用边界。
AI.method: 在铁磁纳米环中实现涡旋核旋进与方位角自旋波模式的强非线性耦合，通过调控孔洞直径（减小保持传统tMFC，增大引入四波混频使梳致密化）以及施加面内磁场（位移涡旋核并改变其约束势）来实现对频率梳的调控。
AI.result: 成功产生tMFC及其高阶模式；增大孔洞尺寸通过四波混频使边带多重性提升一个数量级；面内磁场可实现梳间距的连续可逆调谐，且孔洞引起的几何钉扎在相反磁场极性下呈现不对称切换和磁滞现象。
AI.conclusion: tMFC被确立为多功能非线性磁振子学平台，在可调谐频率梳生成和精密计量方面具有潜在应用价值。

title: Constitutive modelling of open-porous neo-Hookean solids
summary: Open-porous materials exhibit pronounced compressibility, nonlinear densification, and power-law scaling of stiffness with density. In this work, we propose a thermodynamically consistent compressible neo-Hookean constitutive model for open-porous solids in which porosity serves as the primary governing variable. The strain-energy density is formulated to couple distortional elasticity of the solid skeleton with a volumetric response governed by deformation-induced porosity evolution, including a bounded representation of pore collapse. The formulation introduces a minimal set of parameters, namely the initial porosity, intrinsic skeleton moduli, and a scalar parameter controlling the onset of densification. A key feature of the model is a modified volumetric term in which the response is normalised by the current porosity, ensuring a physically consistent transition from a porous to a densified state without artificial stiffening. In the small-strain limit, the model recovers classical linear elasticity with effective moduli that may be chosen either from homogenisation bounds, such as the Hashin-Shtrikman estimates, or from Gibson-Ashby-type power-law scaling to capture topology-dependent behaviour. At finite strains, the formulation captures the characteristic nonlinear stiffening and convex stress-stretch response associated with progressive pore collapse. The proposed framework thus provides a compact, flexible, and extensible constitutive description that unifies effective-medium consistency with experimentally observed scaling behaviour, and is well suited for finite element implementation and multiscale modelling of highly compressible open-porous materials. The model is finally validated against available experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种热力学一致的、可压缩的neo-Hookean本构模型，用于描述开放多孔固体材料。该模型以孔隙率作为主要控制变量，将固体骨架的畸变弹性与孔隙演化驱动的体积响应耦合，并引入有界孔隙塌缩表示。模型参数极少（初始孔隙率、骨架模量、致密化控制标量），在小应变极限下恢复经典线弹性（可选择Hashin-Shtrikman或Gibson-Ashby标度律），在有限应变下捕捉非线性加劲与凸应力-应变响应，并已通过实验数据验证。
AI.motivation: 开放多孔材料表现出显著的压缩性、非线性致密化以及刚度随密度呈幂律标度的行为，现有本构模型难以在统一框架下同时描述这些小应变有效介质行为与有限应变非线性响应，因此需要一种紧凑、灵活且可扩展的本构描述。
AI.method: 提出以孔隙率为主要控制变量的可压缩neo-Hookean本构模型：应变能密度由骨架畸变弹性与变形诱发孔隙演化控制的体积响应耦合组成；采用当前孔隙率归一化的修正体积项，确保从多孔态到致密态的自然过渡；参数仅含初始孔隙率、骨架固有模量及控制致密化起始的标量参数；小应变极限下可选择均质化界限（如Hashin-Shtrikman估计）或Gibson-Ashby幂律标度。
AI.result: 模型在有限应变下成功捕捉了渐进孔隙塌缩引起的非线性加劲和凸应力-应变响应，能够统一有效介质一致性与实验观测到的标度行为，并通过实验数据验证了模型的正确性和适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为高压缩开放多孔材料提供了一种紧凑、灵活且可扩展的本构描述框架，兼具有效介质理论一致性与实验标度行为，适合有限元实现及多尺度模拟。

title: Nonzero-temperature vibronic spectra of polyatomic molecules from a zero-temperature classical trajectory
summary: By combining coherence thermofield dynamics with the single-Hessian approximation, we enable simulations of low- to medium-resolution vibronic spectra of weakly anharmonic systems at nonzero temperatures, at negligible additional cost relative to zero-temperature calculations. Single-Hessian coherence thermofield Gaussian wavepacket dynamics is exact in any harmonic potential, provided that the reference Hessian is that of the final surface. When applied to Morse systems of increasing anharmonicity and varying temperature, this method successfully captures excited-state anharmonicity and key temperature-dependent spectral features, including hot bands and broadening. By combining the method with on-the-fly ab initio dynamics, we demonstrate its utility by computing the absorption spectra of naphthalene, aminocoumarin C450, and phenyl radical, and the photoelectron spectrum of SeO$_{2}^{-}$ . Within the ab initio single-Hessian approximation, after the zero-temperature spectrum is obtained at the cost of classical molecular dynamics (on the order of hours), all nonzero-temperature spectra are computed in seconds.

AI.tldr: 本文结合相干热场动力学与单Hessian近似，实现了在非零温度下弱非谐体系中低至中分辨率振动光谱的模拟，其计算成本与零温计算几乎相同。该方法在谐波势中精确（前提是参考Hessian来自最终面），并能捕获Morse体系中的激发态非谐性和温度相关光谱特征（如热带和展宽）。结合在线从头算动力学，成功计算了萘、氨基香豆素C450、苯基自由基的吸收光谱以及SeO₂⁻的光电子谱，零温光谱获取后（约数小时），所有非零温光谱可在数秒内完成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在计算非零温度下弱非谐体系的振动光谱时面临精度与计算成本的权衡，特别是温度效应对光谱特征（如热带和展宽）的影响难以高效准确捕获。
AI.method: 将相干热场动力学与单Hessian近似相结合，利用单Hessian相干热场高斯波包动力学方法。该方法在谐波势中精确，前提是参考Hessian取自最终势能面。结合on-the-fly从头算动力学进行实际应用。
AI.result: 在Morse体系中成功捕获了激发态非谐性和温度相关光谱特征（包括热带和展宽）；在四个真实体系（萘、氨基香豆素C450、苯基自由基、SeO₂⁻）中成功计算了吸收光谱和光电子谱。计算效率极高：零温光谱需数小时（经典分子动力学成本），但所有非零温光谱仅需数秒。
AI.conclusion: 单Hessian相干热场高斯波包动力学方法是一种高效且可靠的非零温度振动光谱模拟工具，能以接近零温计算的成本处理弱非谐体系，具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Strange Metal Hall Effect in Underdoped BaFe$_2$(As$_{1-x}$P$_x$)$_2$
summary: The unusual transport properties of strange metals point to the breakdown of the quasiparticle picture, the understanding of which remains one of the most vexing problems in physics. Here, we report investigations of the electrical Hall effect of the strange metal superconductor BaFe$_2$(As$_{1-x}$P$_x$)$_2$. We show that a doping-independent contribution to the Hall effect exists within a fan shaped region above a putative quantum critical point. This `strange metal Hall' contribution echoes many of the properties of the antiferromangetic Hall response, but attains universal properties that distinguish it from the effects of Fermi surface reconstruction. This is consistent with an underlying origin connected to the presence of critical fluctuations, tying it to observations of $T$-linear resistivity and the appearance of unconventional superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了奇异金属超导体BaFe₂(As₁₋ₓPₓ)₂的霍尔效应，发现在量子临界点之上的扇形区域内存在一个与掺杂无关的"奇异金属霍尔"贡献。该贡献具有普适性质，与费米面重构效应不同，其起源与临界涨落相关，并与T线性电阻率和非常规超导性的出现相关联。
AI.motivation: 奇异金属的非寻常输运性质表明准粒子图像失效，这是物理学中最棘手的问题之一。理解奇异金属的输运行为（如T线性电阻率）对揭示高温超导和量子临界现象的本质至关重要。本文旨在通过研究霍尔效应来深入理解奇异金属的奇异输运特性。
AI.method: 对奇异金属超导体BaFe₂(As₁₋ₓPₓ)₂进行系统的电霍尔效应测量，分析不同掺杂浓度下霍尔效应的变化规律，识别掺杂无关的霍尔贡献，并与反铁磁霍尔响应进行对比分析。
AI.result: 发现在假定量子临界点之上的扇形区域内存在掺杂无关的"奇异金属霍尔"贡献，该贡献具有普适性质，与费米面重构效应可区分，并与其反铁磁霍尔响应的诸多性质相呼应。
AI.conclusion: "奇异金属霍尔"贡献与临界涨落的存在相关，这与T线性电阻率和非常规超导性的观测一致，为理解奇异金属的微观机制提供了新的证据和视角。

title: Exact Fluctuation-Response Relations for Underdamped Langevin Dynamics
summary: Thermodynamic uncertainty relations connect current fluctuations to dissipation and are often rooted in fluctuation-response principles. In underdamped dynamics, however, conventional mean-current uncertainty relations can fail, while the underlying connection between fluctuations, response, and dissipation remains elusive. Here we uncover this structure by deriving an exact finite-time fluctuation-response equality for underdamped Langevin dynamics, valid for arbitrary time-dependent driving and general additive observables. The equality yields sharp response bounds and a variational characterization of the dynamically generated variance. Choosing the perturbation along the irreversible probability flow gives a friction-response thermodynamic uncertainty relation that can be saturated at any finite observation time, leading to an exact variational principle for the total entropy production. We further show that the conventional uncertainty factor of velocity-resolved currents can decay exponentially with dissipation even in driven free diffusion, while the friction-response factor retains its universal lower bound. These results establish response, rather than the mean current itself, as the quantity directly linking fluctuations and dissipation in underdamped dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欠阻尼朗之万动力学，推导出精确的有限时间涨落-响应等式，建立了波动、响应与耗散之间的深层联系。通过沿不可逆概率流选择微扰，得到一个可饱和的摩擦-响应热力学不确定关系，并揭示传统速度分辨流的不确定因子可能随耗散指数衰减，而响应才是连接波动与耗散的核心量。
AI.motivation: 传统平均流热力学不确定关系在欠阻尼动力学中会失效，而波动、响应和耗散之间的内在联系尚不明确。作者希望填补这一理论空白，建立欠阻尼系统中三者统一的框架。
AI.method: 推导适用于任意时间依赖驱动和一般加性可观测量下的精确有限时间涨落-响应等式；由此获得尖锐的响应上界和动态生成方差的变分刻画；通过沿不可逆概率流选择微扰，构建摩擦-响应热力学不确定关系。
AI.result: 摩擦-响应热力学不确定关系可在任意有限观测时间内饱和，从而给出总熵产生的精确变分原理；传统速度分辨流的常规不确定因子在驱动自由扩散中可随耗散指数衰减，而摩擦-响应因子始终保持普适下界。
AI.conclusion: 在欠阻尼动力学中，响应（而非平均流本身）才是直接连接波动与耗散的量，这为理解欠阻尼系统中的热力学不确定性提供了新的理论范式。

title: Tilted $p$-wave magnet candidate CeNiAsO
summary: The unexpectedly small ordered moments of CeNiAsO, a candidate for correlated $p$-wave magnet, have posed a serious challenge to the precise determination of its magnetic structure, hindering the understanding of its fundamental properties. By leveraging the high sensitivity to local internal fields, our $^{75}$As nuclear quadrupole / magnetic resonance experiments reveal a commensurate antiferromagnetic order with a small out-of-plane moment $m_z\approx0.05$ $μ_{\mathrm{B}}$. This tilted magnetic configuration not only rotates the spin polarization axis away from the crystallographic $\mathbf{c}$-axis, but also enhances the non-relativistic spin splitting. We refer to this rare paradigm as a \textit{tilted $p$-wave magnet}.

AI.tldr: 本文通过75As核四极/磁共振实验，精确测定了CeNiAsO中一种具有微小面外磁矩（mz≈0.05 μB）的共线反铁磁序，并提出"倾斜p波磁体"这一新范式，揭示了非相对论自旋劈裂增强的物理机制。
AI.motivation: CeNiAsO被预测为关联p波磁体，但其磁矩异常微小，导致磁结构难以精确确定，严重阻碍了对其基本物性的理解。
AI.method: 利用75As核四极/磁共振（NQR/NMR）技术，通过对局部内磁场的高灵敏度探测来确定磁结构和磁矩大小及方向。
AI.result: 确定CeNiAsO具有共线反铁磁序，磁矩为面外分量mz≈0.05 μB的倾斜磁构型；这种倾斜排列使自旋极化轴偏离晶体学c轴，同时增强了非相对论自旋劈裂。
AI.conclusion: 提出"倾斜p波磁体"这一罕见范式，为理解关联体系中微小磁矩导致的复杂磁性与自旋劈裂行为提供了新的物理图像。

title: Giant orbital Hall effect from cubic Dresselhaus orbital coupling
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, and supplementary material will be provided in a published version
summary: The orbital Berry curvature (OBC) governs the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity (OHC), a central quantity in orbitronics. Previous approaches for enhancing the OHC have primarily relied on a linearin-momentum, Rashba-type orbital coupling. Here, we show that cubic Dresselhaus orbital coupling offers a new route to enhancing the OHC. Using an effective two-orbital band model, we show that the cubic coupling generates momentum-space hot spots, absent in the purely linear case, at which the OBC is strongly enhanced. This local enhancement, together with the multiplicity of the hot spots, boosts the OHC by more than an order of magnitude relative to the linear-coupling value. We further find that the OHC diverges inversely with the level splitting in the small-splitting limit, with a divergence coefficient universally seventeen times larger than that of the linear case. These results establish cubic Dresselhaus coupling as a route to giant orbital Hall responses, opening new avenues for orbitronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，三次Dresselhaus轨道耦合相较于传统的线性Rashba型轨道耦合，能通过产生动量空间热点显著增强轨道霍尔电导（OHC），提升幅度可达一个数量级以上，并在小能级劈裂极限下表现出普适的17倍发散系数。
AI.motivation: 轨道霍尔电导（OHC）是轨道电子学（orbitronics）的核心量，此前增强OHC的方法主要依赖线性动量依赖的Rashba型轨道耦合，作者希望探索新的物理机制来进一步提升OHC。
AI.method: 采用有效的双轨道能带模型，对比线性与三次Dresselhaus轨道耦合，分析动量空间中的轨道Berry曲率（OBC）分布及其对OHC的贡献，并推导小能级劈裂极限下的发散行为。
AI.result: 三次Dresselhaus耦合在动量空间产生线性情况所没有的热点，局部增强OBC；结合热点多重性使OHC比线性耦合情形提升一个数量级以上；在小劈裂极限下OHC反比于能级劈裂发散，发散系数普适地比线性情形大17倍。
AI.conclusion: 三次Dresselhaus耦合是实现巨轨道霍尔响应的新途径，为轨道电子学器件应用开辟了新方向。

title: Controlling catalyst agglomeration in high-density unordered III-V nanowire growth using Au colloid solutions
summary:
III-V semiconductor nanowires (NWs) are a promising platform for optoelectronic and photoelectrochemical applications, where device performance strongly depends on NW density and spatial arrangement. While ordered arrays provide precise control, their fabrication requires complex and costly lithographic techniques. Unordered growth offers a scalable alternative but is limited by insufficient control over catalyst distribution and particle agglomeration.
  Here, we investigate the density scaling of unordered III-V NW arrays using commercially available Au colloid solutions as catalysts for NW growth via vapor-liquid-solid growth mode. Repeated deposition cycles yield a near-linear increase in particle density, which is ultimately limited by non-linear agglomeration effects not captured by simple stochastic models.
  To address this limitation, a previously established pre-anneal growth concept is transferred from patterned catalyst arrays to randomly deposited Au colloids, thereby suppressing thermally induced coalescence and stabilizing the catalyst distribution. This approach enables up to a tenfold increase in NW density while improving uniformity and vertical yield. The method is demonstrated for colloid diameters between 100 and 200 nm.
  Overall, this work provides a scalable, lithography-free route toward high-density III-V NW ensembles and offers insight into the role of particle dynamics in colloid-based growth processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于商用Au胶体溶液作为催化剂、通过VLS生长模式制备无序III-V半导体纳米线阵列的密度调控方法。研究发现反复沉积可近似线性增加颗粒密度，但受非线性团聚效应限制。通过将预退火生长概念从图案化催化剂阵列迁移至随机沉积的Au胶体，抑制了热致聚并并稳定催化剂分布，实现了纳米线密度高达十倍的提升，同时改善了均匀性和垂直产率。
AI.motivation: III-V半导体纳米线在光电和光电化学应用中性能强烈依赖于纳米线的密度和空间排列。有序阵列虽控制精确但需要复杂昂贵的光刻技术；无序生长虽可扩展但缺乏对催化剂分布和颗粒团聚的控制。因此需要一种既可规模化又可控的方法来调控无序纳米线阵列的密度。
AI.method: 1) 使用商用Au胶体溶液作为催化剂，通过VLS生长模式制备无序III-V纳米线阵列；2) 采用重复沉积循环来增加颗粒密度，并分析其线性增长及非线性团聚限制；3) 将预退火生长概念从图案化催化剂阵列迁移到随机沉积的Au胶体上，以抑制热致聚并并稳定催化剂分布；4) 在100-200 nm胶体直径范围内验证该方法。
AI.result: 反复沉积循环可产生接近线性的颗粒密度增长，但受非线性团聚效应限制。通过预退火生长概念的迁移应用，成功抑制了热诱导聚并，实现了纳米线密度最高达十倍的提升，同时改善了均匀性和垂直产率，并在100-200 nm胶体直径范围内均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一条可规模化、免光刻的高密度III-V纳米线阵列制备路线，并深入揭示了胶体基生长过程中颗粒动力学的作用，为无序纳米线阵列的密度调控提供了新的策略和见解。

title: Incorporating multiscale mechanics in lithium-ion battery models
summary: Lithiation-induced swelling in lithium-ion batteries generates stresses not only within active particles, but also across the surrounding non-active matrix, electrodes, and cell stack. These stresses can modify the chemical potential of lithium and therefore influence transport, reaction kinetics, and terminal voltage. We derive a reduced-order electro-chemo-mechanical model that captures this multiscale coupling while retaining a complexity comparable to standard Doyle--Fuller--Newman models. The electrode is modelled as a periodic array of spherical active particles embedded in a homogenised elastic non-active matrix. Exploiting the small stiffness of the non-active matrix relative to the active material, together with scale separation between particles, electrodes, and the full cell, we obtain an effective mechanical correction to the active-particle chemical potential and overpotential. This correction depends on particle swelling, electrode-scale strain, and macroscopic boundary conditions such as clamping or applied pressure. The resulting formulation can be incorporated directly into DFN, SPMe, and SPM frameworks, providing a computationally efficient route to include battery-scale mechanical effects in electrochemical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种降阶的电-化学-力学耦合模型，在保持与标准Doyle-Fuller-Newman（DFN）模型相当复杂度的前提下，捕捉锂化膨胀引起的多尺度应力耦合效应。该模型将电极建模为嵌入均质化弹性非活性基体中的周期性球形活性颗粒阵列，利用非活性基体刚度小及颗粒-电极-电池间的尺度分离，得到活性颗粒化学势和过电位的有效力学修正项，可直接集成到DFN、SPMe和SPM框架中。
AI.motivation: 锂离子电池中由锂化引起的膨胀会产生应力，这些应力不仅存在于活性颗粒内部，还跨越非活性基体、电极和电池堆。这些应力会改变锂的化学势，从而影响输运、反应动力学和端电压。现有模型难以在保持计算效率的同时捕捉这种多尺度耦合效应。
AI.method: 将电极建模为嵌入均质化弹性非活性基体中的周期性球形活性颗粒阵列；利用非活性基体相对活性材料刚度小的特性，以及颗粒、电极和全电池之间的尺度分离，推导出活性颗粒化学势和过电位的有效力学修正项；该修正项依赖于颗粒膨胀、电极尺度应变以及夹持或施加压力等宏观边界条件；最终将修正项集成到DFN、SPMe和SPM框架中。
AI.result: 得到了一个复杂度与标准DFN模型相当的降阶电-化学-力学模型，能够有效地将电池尺度的力学效应纳入电化学模拟中，计算效率高。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一种计算高效的方法，将电池尺度的机械效应整合到电化学模拟中，同时保持与传统电池模型的复杂度相当，适用于DFN、SPMe和SPM等多种框架。

title: Pair-Density Wave from Doping an Altermagnetic Mott Insulator
summary: Pair-density-wave (PDW) superconductivity is a state in which the superconducting order parameter modulates at a finite wavevector. Using large-scale density matrix renormalization group, we study the doped altermagnetic Mott insulator in the checkerboard $t$-$J$ model, where altermagnetic exchange anisotropy is encoded microscopically through anisotropic ferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor exchange. By mapping the ground-state phase diagram as a function of doping and altermagnetic anisotropy, mainly on six-leg cylinders, we identify a transition from a uniform $d$-wave superconducting regime with charge modulation to a PDW regime coexisting with stripe order. In the PDW regime, we report an unconventional wave-vector locking $\mathbf Q_{\mathrm{PDW}}\approx 2\mathbf Q_{\mathrm{Stripe}}$ along the cylinder direction, in contrast to the conventional relation. Pair correlations reveal a two-scale structure, consisting of short-distance local $d$-wave pairing and long-distance finite-momentum PDW correlations. A symmetry-based Ginzburg--Landau analysis is presented for the observed locking. Our results identify altermagnetism as a strong-coupling, microscopically grounded route to finite-momentum superconductivity in doped Mott insulators.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大规模密度矩阵重整化群方法研究棋盘格t-J模型中的掺杂反铁磁Mott绝缘体，发现随着掺杂和反铁磁各向异性的变化，系统从均匀d波超导态（伴随电荷调制）转变为PDW超导态（伴随条纹序共存）。在PDW区域发现了非常规的波矢锁定关系Q_PDW≈2Q_Stripe，并通过基于对称性的Ginzburg-Landau分析进行解释。
AI.motivation: 探索在掺杂Mott绝缘体中实现有限动量超导（如PDW态）的微观机制，特别是反铁磁（altermagnetism）作为强耦合微观途径的可行性，以区别于传统的有限动量超导来源。
AI.method: 采用大规模密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法，在棋盘格t-J模型中编码反铁磁交换各向异性（通过各向异性铁磁次近邻交换项），在六腿圆柱上绘制基态相图，并结合基于对称性的Ginzburg-Landau分析解释波矢锁定现象。
AI.result: 识别出从均匀d波超导（伴随电荷调制）到PDW超导（与条纹序共存）的相变；在PDW区域发现非常规波矢锁定Q_PDW≈2Q_Stripe；对关联呈现双尺度结构：短程局域d波配对与长程有限动量PDW关联。
AI.conclusion: 反铁磁性可作为掺杂Mott绝缘体中有限动量超导的强耦合微观实现途径，为理解PDW超导态提供了新的物理机制和理论框架。

title: Fluctuation-Controlled Asymmetric Kinetics in Metal-Insulator Transitions
summary: We report asymmetric kinetics in thermally driven metal-insulator transitions (MITs) in 1T-TaS$_2$. Using combined transport, calorimetric, and Raman measurements, we show that the transition proceeds via burst-like avalanches during cooling, while remaining continuous during heating. Although bulk transport is masked by percolative conduction, local probes and thermal measurements reveal intrinsic asymmetry in the transformation pathways. Using controlled nonequilibrium thermal perturbations generated by pulsed Joule heating, we demonstrate that the phase-ordering dynamics remains strongly athermal during cooling, whereas during heating fluctuations progressively overcome nucleation barriers, leading to a smooth transformation. The distinct responses to thermal perturbations indicate different degrees of athermality of the two hysteresis branches, which govern the transformation pathways and give rise to the observed kinetic asymmetry. These results establish a general framework in which the degree of athermality controls pathway selection in first-order phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 该研究报道了1T-TaS₂中热驱动金属-绝缘体相变的不对称动力学：冷却过程中相变以雪崩式爆发进行（非热性主导），而加热过程中则是连续的平滑转变（涨落效应显著）。通过输运、量热和拉曼实验结合脉冲焦耳热扰动，作者证明两条滞回分支具有不同程度的非热性，进而控制了不同的相变路径。
AI.motivation: 金属-绝缘体相变（MIT）的动力学机制对于理解一级相变的理论框架至关重要，但传统观念中常将加热和冷却视为对称的过程。1T-TaS₂中滞回行为的本质尚不清楚，特别是冷却与加热过程中的微观转变路径是否存在本质差异，缺乏直接的实验证据。
AI.method: 结合宏观输运测量、量热测量和拉曼光谱等局部探测手段；利用脉冲焦耳加热产生可控的非平衡热扰动，系统性地扰动冷却和加热两个方向的相变过程，以量化各滞回分支的"非热性"程度（即相变对外部扰动的响应是否偏离热激活行为）。
AI.result: 冷却过程中相变以突发雪崩形式进行，呈现强烈的非热性，对热扰动不敏感；加热过程中相变连续进行，涨落逐渐克服成核势垒，对热扰动敏感。两条滞回分支表现出截然不同的热扰动响应，揭示了转变路径的根本不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个通用框架：在一级相变中，滞回回线的每个分支具有不同程度的非热性，而这一非热性程度决定了相变路径的选择。这为理解更广泛的材料体系中一级相变的动力学不对称性提供了新的理论视角。

title: Volatile resistive-switched state in a bulk organic conductor with a sharp metal-insulator transition
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures + 2 supplemental figures; published in Physical Review Applied
summary: Volatile resistive switching in correlated-electron systems, characterized by an abrupt resistance decrease under applied current, is crucial for developing next-generation electronics. Despite its technological significance, the underlying physics remains elusive. Inorganic thin films on substrates---the widely studied platform for resistive switching---usually exhibit broad temperature-induced metal-insulator transitions (MITs) and substantial heat dissipation. These factors complicate the nonlinear thermal effect induced by Joule heating, a key contributor to resistive switching, rendering it excessively complex and difficult to decipher. Here we investigate a resistive-switched state in the bulk organic conductor ($d$7-DMe-DCNQI)$_{2}$Cu, which undergoes an extremely sharp first-order MIT and exhibits weak heat dissipation, using resistance and $^{1}$H-NMR measurements. These extreme conditions make the Joule heating effect vivid, allowing us to observe peculiar phenomena, including temperature locking to the MIT and `inverse Ohm's law'---an inverse proportionality between voltage and current. These findings provide fundamental insights into the nonlinear thermal effect in resistive switching, offering a pathway to efficient resistive-switching technologies.

title: Coherence protection of a silicon hole spin qubit with phase-modulated microwave driving
summary: Hole spins in silicon quantum dots are a promising platform for quantum computing due to their strong intrinsic spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which enables fast, all-electrical control. However, this coupling also increases their susceptibility to charge noise, thereby limiting coherence times. Moreover, holes in silicon are also affected by hyperfine interactions with residual nuclear spins in the silicon substrate, introducing a non-negligible source of low-frequency noise. Here, we implement a phase-modulated concatenated continuous driving (CCD) technique for hole spin qubits to suppress low-frequency noise through microwave phase modulation. This approach stabilizes Rabi oscillations and extends the oscillation decay time compared to the conventional method. Furthermore, by defining a qubit in the CCD frame, we achieve coherent control while simultaneously protecting the qubit from noise, confirming coherence protection during gate operations. These results demonstrate a viable route toward noise-robust hole spin qubits.

title: Building atomistic models of heterointerfaces with optimal transport
summary: Heterogeneous interfaces underpin technologies from microelectronics to energy conversion and storage, but their configurational complexity precludes exhaustive first-principles screening of interface registries. Although data-driven approaches can alleviate this burden, they remain limited by sparse interface datasets. Here, we introduce an energy-independent workflow that represents coherent interfaces as attributed graphs, quantifies their similarity to parent bulk environments using the fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) distance, and couples this metric with Bayesian optimization over the in-plane registry space. We assess the approach for KI/NaCl, GaP/GaAs and GaN/$\mathrm{Al_{2}O_{3}}$ interfaces spanning ionic, covalent and mixed-bonding regimes, using hierarchical validation with MACE and density functional theory (DFT). Comparison with single-point energy landscapes shows that the FGW distance captures registry-dependent periodicity, while interfaces exhibit deviations between structural and energetic extrema, reflecting additional chemistry-specific contributions. Furthermore, FGW distances show an overall association with relaxed energies. Under limited screening budgets, FGW-guided registry selection consistently outperforms random search and is more robust across interface systems than selection guided by pretrained MACE energies. The workflow converts the qualitative notion of bulk-like continuity into a quantitative prescreening criterion, enabling efficient registry exploration and providing physically informed candidate structures for materials discovery workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种能量无关的界面筛选工作流，将相干界面表示为属性图，用融合Gromov-Wasserstein距离量化其与母体体相环境的相似性，并耦合贝叶斯优化进行界面配准空间搜索，在多种键合类型的界面体系中验证了其优于随机搜索和预训练MACE能量引导的筛选性能。

title: Observables and Anti-Hermitian Generators in Time-Dependent Unitary Coupled Cluster Theory
summary: This work presents a time-dependent (TD) unitary coupled-cluster (UCC) formulation for electronic quantum dynamics, including the propagation of excited states and their superpositions, in both single- and multi-reference regimes. Standard TD coupled-cluster techniques offer size-extensivity, but they rely on non-Hermitian bivariational action functionals that break time-reversibility, giving transition matrix elements and amplitude estimators that are asymmetric (though accurate and systematically improvable). Here we use the time-evolution operator as an exponential map driven by TD anti-Hermitian cluster operators and first-order generators. Applying the Dirac-Frenkel action principle, we extract equations of motion governed by Heisenberg-picture-like commutators. This approach connects to our previous non-Hermitian formulations, where observables are expressed in terms of regular and extended cluster operators. From that connection we obtain a generator cluster operator whose unperturbed TD limit leads to the UCC eigenvalue problem. Even though this problem can be exact, the time dependence of the generator holds only at short propagation times, so we use the generator to prepare the initial state and then propagate that state with the formal TD UCC equation of motion. The theory is tested on an extended hard-core Bose-Hubbard ring with connections to neutral atom chains, and we discuss the theory's present limitations and possible extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种含时幺正耦合簇（TD-UCC）形式体系，用于电子量子动力学，涵盖激发态及其叠加态的传播（单参考和多参考情形）。该方法使用含时反厄米簇算符驱动的指数时间演化算子，并基于Dirac-Frenkel作用量原理导出运动方程，同时与先前非厄米形式体系建立联系。该方法在扩展硬核Bose-Hubbard环上进行了测试。

AI.method: 利用含时反厄米簇算符和一阶生成元驱动的指数映射（时间演化算子），应用Dirac-Frenkel作用量原理导出由类Heisenberg对易子控制的运动方程；从与先前非厄米公式的联系中获得生成元簇算符，用于制备初始态，然后以正式TD-UCC运动方程传播该态。
AI.result: 理论在扩展硬核Bose-Hubbard环（与中性原子链相关）上进行了数值测试，验证了方法的适用性，同时指出了当前理论的局限性及可能的扩展方向。

title: Splitting probabilities for Brownian motion with diffusing boundaries: Application to polymer translocation
summary: We study the translocation of a polymer chain through a nanopore where the chain length fluctuates stochastically due to the polymerization-depolymerization processes at the chain ends. We map this process to an equivalent representation where the pore performs a stochastic random-walk-like process on a line in the presence of two diffusing sinks on either side of it with diffusion constants $D_1$ and $D_3$ respectively. The translocation process terminates when the pore hits either of the two outer diffusing sinks. In the case where the pore motion itself is diffusive with diffusion constant $D_2$, we compute exactly the splitting probability that the pore hits the left (right) sink before hitting the right (left) sink. We show that the splitting probability in the presence of mobile sinks is rather nontrivial compared to the classical case of immobile sinks (the latter corresponds to the case when the chain length is fixed). Furthermore, we also compute exactly the probability distribution of the translocation time and that of the chain length at the completion time of the translocation. We show that both distributions have power law tails with exponents that depend continuously on the diffusion constants $D_1$, $D_2$ and $D_3$. We validate our analytical predictions via numerical simulations. We then present numerical results for the case when the pore performs a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst exponent $0<H<1$, while the sinks are still diffusive.

AI.tldr: 本文研究聚合物链通过纳米孔的易位过程，其中链长因聚合-解聚过程而随机波动。作者将该过程映射为孔在一条线上执行随机游走，两侧各有一个扩散陷阱的等效表示。当孔的运动也是扩散时，作者精确计算了分裂概率、易位时间分布和完成时链长分布，发现这些分布在移动陷阱情况下比固定陷阱情况更复杂，且具有幂律尾部，指数连续依赖于三个扩散常数。作者还通过数值模拟验证了分析结果，并扩展到孔做分数布朗运动的情形。

title: Biorthogonal Conformal Dynamics in Non-Hermitian Quantum Quenches
summary: Global quenches at one-dimensional critical points admit a boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) description in which Euclidean strip correlators are analytically continued to real time. We formulate this construction for interacting non-Hermitian critical systems, where a right ket alone does not specify the dynamical readout and the left covector is part of the microscopic quench protocol. Independent left and right preparations flowing to the same conformal boundary define the two temporal boundaries of a strip with generally complex one-sided extrapolation parameters; linear and antilinear symmetry pairings are exploited to constrain this geometry. In the interacting Yang-Lee spin chain, statically calibrated boundary data determine the biorthogonal dynamics of the complete-character return amplitude, a primary one-point function, and a spatial correlator. The imaginary part of the linear-paired extrapolation parameter predicts the temporal center of an independently evolved antilinear-paired one-point function at the $10^{-3}$ relative level; the same preparation phase controls local phase evolution and the analytic-continuation path of boundary blocks. Further results test this formalism with a direct field-on quench, mixed left and right preparations, and a complex five-state Potts fixed point with complex primary dimensions. These results establish a BCFT framework for biorthogonal global quenches in interacting non-Hermitian critical systems, in which complex temporal-boundary data organize universal post-quench dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一维临界点上的双正交全局淬火（global quench）的边界共形场论（BCFT）框架，适用于相互作用的非厄米临界系统。通过独立左、右态制备流到同一共形边界，定义了一个具有复值外推参数的带状几何，并利用线性和反线性对称配对约束该几何。在相互作用的Yang-Lee自旋链中，静态校准的边界数据成功预测了双正交动力学，包括完整特征返回振幅、单点函数和空间关联函数，达到10^-3相对精度。
AI.motivation: 传统的BCFT淬火形式仅适用于厄米系统，其右ket足以指定动力学读数。然而在非厄米临界系统中，动力学读数需要同时依赖右ket和左covector，后者是微观淬火协议的一部分，这使得原有的BCFT构造无法直接适用。作者旨在将全局淬火的BCFT描述推广到相互作用的非厄米临界系统。

AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了适用于相互作用的非厄米临界系统中双正交全局淬火的BCFT框架，其中复值的时间边界数据组织普遍的淬火后动力学，为理解和预测非厄米临界系统远离平衡态的普适行为提供了理论工具。

title: Pressure-tuning of electronic structure of CeTe3 probed by femtosecond collective mode spectroscopy
summary: We use femtosecond optical spectroscopy to study the evolution of coherent order-parameter dynamics in the prototypical charge-density-wave (CDW) system CeTe3 under hydrostatic pressure. The CDW transition temperature decreases from approximately 570 K at ambient pressure to near room temperature at approximately 6 GPa. The pressure dependence of the order-parameter recovery dynamics indicates enhanced electron-phonon coupling with increasing pressure, implying that CDW suppression is driven predominantly by the reduction in Fermi-surface nesting. Above 7 GPa, no evidence of CDW order is observed down to cryogenic temperatures. Concurrently, the relaxation dynamics exhibit significant slowing down at low-temperatures, consistent with emerging heavy-electron behaviour due to pressure-enhanced hybridization between localized Ce 4f levels and itinerant carriers.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用飞秒光学光谱技术，在静水压力下研究了原型电荷密度波（CDW）材料CeTe3中有序参量动力学的演化。随着压力从常压升高到约6 GPa，CDW转变温度从约570 K降至近室温。压力依赖的有序参量恢复动力学表明电子-声子耦合随压力增强，暗示CDW抑制主要由费米面嵌套减少驱动。在7 GPa以上，即使冷却到低温也未观察到CDW序。同时，低温下弛豫动力学显著减慢，与压力增强Ce 4f局域电子与巡游载流子杂化导致的近重费米子行为一致。
AI.motivation: 理解CDW有序态在压力下的失稳机制，区分费米面嵌套与电子-声子耦合两种竞争因素在CDW形成中的作用，并探索压力调控下局域与巡游电子杂化行为。
AI.method: 采用飞秒光学光谱（超快泵浦-探测）技术，在静水压力条件下实时监测CeTe3中有序参量恢复动力学和载流子弛豫行为，系统测量从常压至7 GPa以上的压力范围。
AI.result: 发现CDW转变温度随压力单调下降（570 K→室温）；恢复动力学显示电子-声子耦合随压力增强，表明费米面嵌套减少是CDW抑制的主因；7 GPa以上CDW完全消失；低温下弛豫显著减慢，出现压力诱导的近重费米子行为特征。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了压力通过减少费米面嵌套来抑制CDW序的微观机制，同时发现压力增强Ce 4f杂化导致重费米子行为的涌现，为理解CDW与强关联电子体系之间的竞争与合作提供了超快动力学证据。

title: Search for Majorana Bound States in Short Chains of Proxmitised Quantum Dots
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, presented at The European Conference Physics of Magnetism 2026, Poznań, POLAND
summary: Majorana zero modes (MZM) appearing at the ends of artificially created one-dimensional p-wave superconductors have been intensively studied recently both theoretically and experimentally. Among possible platforms, proximitised semiconducting wires, and short chains of quantum dots with a superconductor in between were investigated. Here, we propose a different platform consisting of a chain of quantum dots (QDs) sandwiched between an s-wave superconductor and a strong spin-orbit semiconductor, subject to a Zeeman magnetic field. Neglecting spin-conserving hopping processes between QDs and local on-dot superconducting correlations induced by the superconducting proximity effect, reduces the Hamiltonian to the sum of two equivalent Hamiltonians with two independent Hilbert spaces. The resulting model has a staggered structure due to spin-flipping processes $t_{so}$ and cross-Andreev reflections $Δ_{CAR}$ between neighbouring dots. Our central result is the phase diagram of a short chain consisting of four QDs and coupled to two external reservoirs, obtained by means of the Green function in chiral Majorana representation. The modulus of the retarded Green function, probing the whole chain and calculated for zero energy, is shown to contain information on topology and spatial character of Majorana zero modes. The features observed in the Green function nicely agree with those obtained from the transfer matrix approach. In particular the region in parameter space in which Majorana zero modes display oscillatory wave functions are well reproduced. Likewise the borders of the fermion parity changes obtained by the Green function agree with those obtained by other means.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的马约拉纳零模（MZM）实现平台：将量子点链夹在s波超导体和强自旋轨道半导体之间，并施加塞曼磁场。通过忽略自旋守恒跳跃和局域超导关联，哈密顿量可分解为两个等效的独立希尔伯特空间哈密顿量。通过手性马约拉纳表示下的格林函数方法，作者给出了四个量子点短链的相图，并证明零能延迟格林函数的模包含拓扑和MZM空间特征的信息，与转移矩阵方法结果吻合。
